basis: Original visual observations by Codex after inspecting the three licensed, resized JPEGs; not external textual quotations or model recognition results.
limitations: These observations apply only to screenshots2,3,4, not the whole film, camera motion, editing, symbolism, character identity or author intent.

observations.text: Screenshot2: a golden dragon head fills the right foreground against a darker, cool, blurred background.
Screenshot3: a winged dragon occupies the center, above an out-of-focus reaching hand; the sky is warm and pale.
Screenshot4: a dark-clothed human face and extended hands stand against a hazy, pale blue-gray background.
